decision: Keep Norwegian Coastal Current route separate; unresolved broad Norwegian Current name is not merged with the coastal or Atlantic flow.

evidence.supports: Broad northeastward flow off Norway; lacks water-mass, branch and endpoint details sufficient for alias resolution.

evidence.citation: Christensen et al. (2026), Norkyst version 3, doi:10.5194/gmd-19-2785-2026
evidence.supports: Explicitly distinguishes warm saline Norwegian Atlantic Current and mixed/fresher Norwegian Coastal Current, with coastal flow from Skagerrak into Barents Sea.

evidence.locator: Introduction paragraphs 3-7; section 3 paragraph 12/Figures 4-5; section 5 paragraph 24
evidence.supports: Ingoy convergence and slope/offshore branches; winter coastal water narrower/deeper and summer wider/shallower. Local section and transport-support widths are not uniform route width.

source_water_origin_not_route_start: The 2011 paper uses Baltic entrance to Skagerrak as freshwater origin. OSW route starts on the Norwegian coastal approach and excludes Baltic source-water travel.
branch_policy: Slope/offshore components near Ingoy do not establish separate globally inventoried current identities; no new alias or branch entity admitted.

seasonal_support.winter: Deeper and more coast-confined coastal waters.
seasonal_support.summer: Shallower and farther offshore coastal waters.
seasonal_support.calendar_warning: ADCP velocity table uses JFM/AMJ/JAS/OND; do not substitute these for hydrographic Figure 4 DJF.
numeric_widths_not_admitted: Less-than-100 km winter coastal-water confinement is an upper bound on water-mass extent, not exact matched velocity width.
Approximately 100 km by 300 m in discussion paragraph 24 is a cross-section approximation supporting baroclinic transport error analysis, not representative full-route width.
15 km continental-slope width in paragraph 7 is bathymetric, not measured current width.

future_animation_data_path.locator: Sections 5 and Code and data availability
future_animation_data_path.next_action: Acquire within-month temporal support and treat tides; define water-mass/velocity boundaries before width inference. Expand spatial fields and validate geometry before occupied-current maps.
future_animation_data_path.admission_status: Twelve 2024 hourly 10 m hindcast subsets acquired and validated for synchronized regional field-map and section animation; no current boundary, width, length or state footprint admission.

remaining_gates: Resolve broad Norwegian Current usage from physical/source conventions.
Verify coastal-water path and coarse shoreline with bathymetry/fine coast.
Extract compatible repeated transverse sections before numeric season/annual claims.
